name: Pearl Oyster
summary: Forgiving beginner oyster. Fast, lots of fresh air, cool-to-room fruiting.
notes: Clusters fruit quickly. Prioritize fresh air over extra humidity once pins form.
chamber_notes: Shrooly-sized chamber works well. Keep surfaces just barely glistening, not dripping.

source_notes.title: Stamets
source_notes.detail: Paul Stamets, Growing Gourmet and Medicinal Mushrooms (commonly cited chamber ranges). P. ostreatus spawn run ~24 °C; fruiting often 10 to 21 °C at 85 to 90% humidity.

source_notes.title: Vendor cards
source_notes.detail: Published grow-card ranges from culinary spawn suppliers (FreshCap, North Spore, Out-Grow and similar). Pearl/grey oysters typically 12 to 12 light and plenty of fresh air.

source_notes.title: Stock firmware
source_notes.detail: Original Shrooly oyster LUA used ~10 h photoperiod and a ramped fan cycle.

stages.name: Colonization
stages.notes: Dark, little fresh air until the block is white.

stages.name: Pinning
stages.notes: Drop temperature and add fresh air to trigger clusters.

stages.name: Fruiting
stages.notes: Harvest when caps flatten and edges just begin to upturn.
